manifest: lool framework-lock — PDP 模板锁（loollook.com 眼镜产品页）
source: loollook.com PDP 设计稿（Lovable fork: lucasxue2/loollook.com）

sections.name: Hero
sections.locked: 产品主图 + 标题 + 价格 + CTA

psych.buyer_question: Is this the right pair for me?
psych.content_goal: 3 秒内建立产品认知：好看、专业、值得买

sections.name: VirtualTryOn
sections.locked: 虚拟试戴入口按钮 + 说明文字

psych.buyer_question: Can I see it on my face?
psych.content_goal: 引导用户用真实摄像头试戴，建立拥有感

sections.name: Overview
sections.locked: H1 + 描述 + 价格 + 镜片选项 + 配送信息

psych.content_goal: 30 秒建立完整产品认知：镜框+镜片+价格+配送

sections.name: LensOptions
sections.locked: 镜片品牌层级展示（lool House → Mingyue → Essilor/ZEISS → Transitions）

psych.buyer_question: Which lens is right for me?
psych.content_goal: 清晰展示镜片层级和价格差异，帮助用户做出选择
用材质和工艺细节建立品质信任

sections.name: PDMeasure
sections.locked: PD 测量工具入口 + 说明

psych.buyer_question: How do I get my PD?
psych.content_goal: 消除 PD 测量恐惧——手机 30 秒搞定

sections.name: ProgressiveGuarantee
sections.locked: 渐进镜片 3 周适应保障声明

psych.buyer_question: What if progressives don't work for me?
psych.content_goal: 3 周适应保障消除渐进镜片购买恐惧

sections.name: ProductData
sections.locked: 规格表（镜框尺寸/材质/重量）

psych.buyer_question: Will it fit? Are the specs right?
psych.content_goal: 硬核规格消除尺寸恐惧
Free shipping over $69 + 30-day returns（plano）消除物流恐惧

sections.name: Reviews
sections.locked: 评价模块（初期空窗期用 FAQ 兜底）

psych.content_goal: 真实评论/FAQ 建立信任
逐条清掉下单前最后的疑虑

sections.name: StickyBuyBar
sections.locked: 固定底栏（价格+加购按钮）

psych.content_goal: 零风险感推动此刻下单
HK Lool Vision 实体可信度兜底

constraints.note: loollook 实际 SSR title 落在 63–68 字符，description 约 200 字符；保留 SEO 安全上限而非 Fuzz 通用硬顶

psych.buyer_question: Is this what I searched for?
psych.content_goal: 搜索承诺与页面兑现完全一致

trusted_tokens: Free tracked shipping on orders over $69
trust_kit.trusted_numbers_note: 26=reader 基础价($); 30=退换天数; 69=满额包邮门槛; 150=通用镜腿长(mm); 14=语言数(2026-11-02 政策统一 V1.1.0)

delivery_rule.standard: Free tracked shipping on orders over $69
delivery_rule.returns: 30-day free returns & exchanges for non-prescription glasses

ai_vs_real_policy.rule: AI 概念对象只准出现在 Story 段且必须带标注词；VirtualTryOn 文案必须强调真实摄像头而非 AI 换脸/生成。
